tasks.title: Next WGS-size run: measurements
tasks.desc:
Why: several speedups and safeguards can only be judged on a whole-genome-size input; panel fixtures are too small.

State: F1830_union (2026-10-19) took 23.7 h vs 56.6 h before; since then the chunked table step, naive concat, score cache and host exclusion were added and F2005_union re-ran in 4.8 h with 100% cache hits. No WGS run has measured a sample with new sites yet.

To measure on the next real WGS sample:
- TSV_TO_TABLE succeeds on the first attempt; TAG fits 24 GB
- score cache: hit rate and time saved on a sample with new sites
- CONCAT_VEP / MERGE time with the new identity check (MISC-6)
- first-attempt hangs (MISC-16) and slow nodes (MISC-17)
- row order of the final table
- AlphaGenome AVI cost inside VEP
You choose the sample and launch; I write the checklist before and the timing report after.

Done when: a walkthrough with the numbers, and each item closed or reopened with evidence.
Source: TODO.md items "Performance review follow-ups", "score cache: WGS measurement", "Row order", "Scheduler problems", "AlphaGenome AVI".

tasks.title: Reconcile stale 'verify on cluster' items
tasks.desc:
Why: TODO.md has about eight "verify on the cluster" items from October whose code later ran in fixtures. Left open they hide what is really unverified, and they would move to this board as noise.

Items: VEP field cleanup, manifest database releases, ClinVar custom annotation, run layout + QC report, NMD plugin load, gene constraint (gnomAD v4.1.2) + PRED-13, AF/ClinVar contract, PRED-6 (missing SpliceAI no longer 0).

To do: for each, cite the run that verified it and close it, or reduce it to the part still unverified. No new runs.

Done when: each item is closed or rewritten to its real open part.

tasks.title: Triage bug rows pointing at shared/utils or retired code
tasks.desc:
Why: seven open rows point at shared/utils or at the legacy bash path retired on 2026-10-08. Some may be fixed, gone, or belong to Module 3 (scoring/ACMG), so the open count is not trustworthy.

Rows: ACMG-1 (PP3_Strong from one tool), ACMG-2 (two BA1/BS1 policies), ACMG-3 (uncalibrated priority score), ACMG-5 (compound-het trans phasing), PRED-1 (Pangolin heart scores = max over tissues), C7 (genotype fields never requested), DOC-2 (duplicate parsers).

To do: re-check each against the vendored parser (src/python/parsing/) with a file:line read now; then close it, mark it Module 3's, or keep it with the corrected location.

Done when: each row has a current verdict.

tasks.title: Pin tool environments: first slice
tasks.desc:
Why: today the tools run from shared conda envs that can change under the pipeline, so the same commit can give different results. Marked PRIORITY by you (2026-10-01).

State: parser code vendored; the manifest records env fingerprints, but no env can be rebuilt from the repo.

First slice: lockfile-built envs (or containers) for spliceai_env, pangolin_env and genomics, referenced by the pipeline and recorded in the manifest. Shared envs untouched; where the new envs live needs your OK.

Done when: the three envs rebuild from files in the repo and a fixture run uses them with unchanged output.
Later slices: spip_env, vcf_parser, datasci; removing the /home fallback.
Source: TODO.md "Pin the run's environments".

tasks.title: Declared test environment + pandas 3 (MISC-25)
tasks.desc:
Why: running the test suite now needs a hand-assembled environment (local datasci + bcftools from genomics + vcf_parser on PYTHONPATH); the shared datasci lacks pytest and pysam. A rebuilt env would also pick pandas 3, under which 6 test modules fail (MISC-25).

To do: declare one test env (pandas, pyarrow, pysam, pytest, bcftools/tabix) with a documented command; either support pandas 3's str dtype in chunked.py or pin pandas < 3 explicitly.

Done when: one documented command runs the full suite green.
Source: BUG_TRACKER.md MISC-25; TODO.md checklist step 2.

tasks.title: NMD: frameshift PTC position and start-proximal rule
tasks.desc:
Why: NMD_STATUS will decide whether PVS1 is downgraded (ClinGen PVS1 tree). Two of its rules are wrong today, so wiring it into PVS1 would misgrade loss-of-function variants.

State: the VEP NMD plugin loads on the cluster and fills NMD_STATUS (checked 2026-10-13). PVS1 is not wired to it yet; that wiring is your decision after this fix.

To do:
- Frameshifts: compute the new stop from HGVSp (fsTer<n>) and the exon structure, then apply last-exon / last-50-nt; today the plugin judges the variant position.
- Separate the "first 100 coding bases" rule: in the ClinGen tree that is the alternative-start branch, not NMD escape.

Done when: NMD_STATUS says which rule fired; tests on synthetic transcripts for each rule; fixture run unchanged outside these rows.
Source: TODO.md "NMD escape", sub-items 1-2.

tasks.title: PM2: gnomAD v4 coverage for absent sites
tasks.desc:
Why: a variant absent from gnomAD counts toward PM2 even at sites gnomAD barely sequenced, where absence means nothing (ClinGen SVI PM2 guidance).

To do: add a gnomAD v4 coverage resource (needs your OK for the download/build and where it lives) and give absent-but-uncovered sites their own status, with no PM2.

Done when: new status value, tests, fixture run; Module 3 told of the new value.
Source: TODO.md "1b. gnomAD coverage for PM2".

tasks.title: UTRAnnotator uORF class picked by hash order (PRED-15)
tasks.desc:
Why: with several 5'UTR effects, UTRAnnotator reports one uORF class chosen by Perl hash order, so the value changes between runs and a high-impact effect can be dropped. Measured: 47 of 1,780 shared rows differ between F2005_union and F1830_union_avi, 6 change high_impact/other.

The plugin is the shared copy in /data_lab_PGP/resources (not this repo's), so this starts with your choice:
(a) a local plugin copy that emits every class (we own a fork), or
(b) accept and document the instability.

Done when: (a) same input gives the same value across runs, tested on a multi-effect variant; or (b) documented and Module 3 told.
Source: BUG_TRACKER.md PRED-15; walkthrough/20261104_utrannotator_high_impact_grading.md.

tasks.title: SPiP positional field indexing (PRED-5)
tasks.desc:
Why: the SPiP parser reads fields by position (f[4], f[11], f[12]); a change in SPiP's output format would silently shift values into the wrong columns. The wrong-gene part of PRED-5 is already fixed.

To do: read fields by the names in SPiP's VCF INFO header and fail loudly on a mismatch. Needs a real SPiP v2.1 output, taken from an existing fixture run (no new run).

Done when: parser keyed by field name; a test with reordered fields; fixture table unchanged.
Source: BUG_TRACKER.md PRED-5.

tasks.title: Decide the next predictor
tasks.desc:
Why: the candidate thesis direction is a predictor-agnostic map of non-coding splice hotspots in haploinsufficiency genes, MYBPC3 first. The next predictor should be the one that adds most there.

Candidates: SQUIRLS (non-canonical splice), AbSplice (heart LV / atrial appendage), SAI-10k-calc, NCBoost v2, popEVE (missense).
For each: what it adds over SpliceAI / Pangolin / SPiP / LaBranchoR / ReMM / AVI, a GRCh38 release, licence, cost (precomputed vs inference), broad or gene-restricted tier.

Done when: a short memo in walkthrough/ and your choice; implementation becomes a separate task.
Source: TODO.md Phase 5.

tasks.desc:

Decide first: kanvas.json is now gitignored (keeps run manifests clean), so the board has no history and no backup in git. If it becomes the only tracker, losing the file loses the state. Option: track kanvas.json in git and exclude it from the manifest's dirty check instead (src/python/write_run_manifest.py).

To do, after TH-01/TH-02 have cleaned the lists:
- one board task per open item worth keeping; bug IDs (PRED-, MISC-) kept in titles;
- TODO.md / BUG_TRACKER.md keep evidence and history, frozen as an archive with a pointer to the board;
- update the project CLAUDE.md line on the source of truth.

Done when: every open item is on the board or explicitly dropped, and the two files say where status now lives.
